cases.reference: D_a(D_b f) == D_b(D_a f) at every point, including corners

cases.name: fd.tensor_field.interior
cases.notes: 16 components x 3 axes, each with a distinct analytic form; tolerance is 1.5x the leading truncation term h^2|f'''|/6
cases.reference: every rank-2 component is differentiated against its own analytic derivative (interior points)

cases.name: fd.tensor_field.boundary
cases.notes: reported separately from the interior, always; the one-sided constant is 2x the centred one, hence the larger bound
cases.reference: same, at boundary points using one-sided stencils

cases.name: fd.tensor_field.time_slot_zero
cases.notes: the frozen-time assumption is explicit at the call site, never implicit in the operator
